desc:
✨ Step into a Harry Potter–inspired wizarding adventure—explore social hangouts, battlefields, and PvP duels while mastering hexes, curses, and countless spells.

⚔️ GAMEPLAY MECHANICS
- Press R to open your spell wheel. (Press ZXCV to open Wheels 1-4, or press Tab to cycle to your next wheel)
- Edit your 4 layouts to your liking.
- Select a spell and click to cast.
- Press Q to block incoming attacks.
- Press Left Control or hold the Dash button on mobile to roll dash.

⚡ CLASH CHALLENGE
- When two spells collide mid-air, a clash begins.
- Click/tap when the dot is in the orange arc. Misclicking will set you back.

📖 SPELLBOOK
- Click the book icon at the bottom-left to view every spell in the game.

🏆 PROGRESSION & REWARDS
- Climb the ranks by winning clashes and earning experience.
- Reach A rank to unlock a free two-shot wand for surprise double casts.

Jump into Spellbound, master your spells, and become the Grand Duelist!
